baseline: lowest of three clean RAGAS runs, minus 0.03

ragas.floors_note: Run-to-run variance on unchanged code is up to 0.06 in context_precision, concentrated in the multi-source questions, so floors are set from three runs, not one.
ragas.abstention_note: 2 of 3: one out-of-scope question sometimes asks back instead of refusing.

sprint_recovery_scenarios.note: Graded by keyword, so a correct answer in other words can miss once.

retrieval.note: eval/retrieval_hit.py: labelled semantic questions sent straight to /search (hybrid + rerank, no query rewriting). Deterministic, so the slack allows one more missed question, not run-to-run noise.
